title: ExamOven Demo Exam 2026 - Mathematics - Calculus - Integration (MathJax)
subject: Mathematics

questions.q:
ExamOven supports **MathJax** for rendering complex mathematical equations. 

Evaluate the following integral:

$$ \int_{0}^{\pi} \sin(x) \, dx $$
questions.explain:
The integral of $\sin(x)$ is $-\cos(x)$.

Evaluating from $0$ to $\pi$:
$$ [-\cos(x)]_{0}^{\pi} = (-\cos(\pi)) - (-\cos(0)) $$
$$ = (-(-1)) - (-1) = 1 + 1 = 2 $$
